LAzbrcPeir97Cfq5hOfdwA.zh: 亞塞拜然西北部薩穆赫區(Samukh)於8/12爆發疫情,累計1例確定病例與9例疑個案,患者均具牛隻接觸史,初期因食用受污染肉品出現腸胃道及皮膚病變,現已收治隔離且病況穩定。當局指出,極端乾旱促使牲畜接觸受孢子污染的土壤衍生此波疫情,目前已啟動跨部門應變機制並強化屠宰管制。未經治療之腸胃道炭疽病例致死率高達25%至60%,及早診斷與介入治療為當前疫情防治之重點工作。
LAzbrcPeir97Cfq5hOfdwA.en: An outbreak occurred in Samukh district in north-western Azerbaijan on 12 August, with 1 confirmed and 9 suspected cases cumulatively; all patients had contact with cattle. Initially, patients developed gastrointestinal and skin lesions after eating contaminated meat. Patients have now been admitted and isolated, and their condition is stable. Authorities say extreme drought caused livestock to come into contact with spore-contaminated soil, leading to this outbreak; a cross-departmental response mechanism has been activated and slaughter controls strengthened. Untreated gastrointestinal anthrax has a case fatality rate of 25% to 60%, so early diagnosis and treatment are the priorities.
